Arm astcenc 5.7.0, commit baff485b0ff36d2f95d28961605106502c653966.
Copyright 2011-2026 Arm Limited. Apache License 2.0 (LICENSE.txt).
https://github.com/ARM-software/astc-encoder/tree/5.7.0

The optional desktop executable is downloaded from Arm's release archives,
with a pinned SHA-256. It is not part of the Android runtime. Preserve these
notices with a downloaded tool and with the Windows converter bundle.

The converter's BC decoder is bcdec (its existing license is in ../bcdec/).
The runtime's zstd decoder uses the BSD license option in ../zstd/LICENSE.

Third-party code in the optional CLI (same pinned source commit):
